source: power-stations-verified.json snapshot, verified live 2026-10-05 with the corrections in docs/solar-calculator/VERIFY-ups.md

conventions.usableKwh: Nominal LFP pack energy (DC). Notebookcheck two-load fits imply 97-101% of nominal is reachable before BMS cut-off, so treat nominal as usable DC and apply a reserve SoC (default 10%) in the simulator. AC energy delivered is lower - see the loss model.
conventions.fixedLossW: P0 in P_dc = P_ac/0.94 + P0, fitted to Notebookcheck drain tests at ~200 W and 1800 W (scripts/fit_losses.py, loss-fits.json). Default when null: 20 W for 1-2 kWh units, 30 W for 3-4 kWh units, sensitivity 10-45 W.
conventions.bypassOverheadW: Not measured anywhere I could find. Model a constant 8 W (sensitivity 3-20 W) of controller/fan/charger standby whenever the unit sits in bypass 24/7; every 10 W costs about £17.5/yr at 20 p.
conventions.roundTripFormula: AC->AC round trip at load L = eta_ch * eta_inv * L / (L + P0 * eta_inv). The report table omitted eta_inv (0.88*500/(500+19)=0.85 is wrong; correct value at P0=20 W is 0.80 at 500 W and 0.76 at 200 W). sim_ups.py already uses the correct form.
conventions.pvInputs: Per-input limits transcribed from pvVoltageRange; pvWireablePanels = typical 400–450 W panels that can actually be connected (VERIFY-ups).
